service: Node AI RAG Service & Gemini Chatbot

architectureStack.vectorDatabase: PostgreSQL with pgvector extension (Neon DB / Supabase)
architectureStack.reasoningModel: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash with multi-doc retrieval
architectureStack.pipelineIntegration: Spring Boot CompletableFuture parallel ingestion pipeline

endpoints.name: Health Check
endpoints.description: Checks the operational status of the Node AI RAG service, database connectivity, and vector extension.

endpoints.name: Process Tender Document (Chunking & Embeddings)
endpoints.description: Extracts text from Tender PDF specification, splits into semantically coherent chunks, generates 768-dim embeddings via Gemini, and indexes them into PostgreSQL pgvector table.

200_OK.message: Tender document vectorized and indexed successfully into pgvector.

endpoints.name: Process Bidder Document (Chunking & Embeddings)
endpoints.description: Parses bidder submission documents (e.g. GST Certificate, Audited Balance Sheet, Work Experience), generates dense embeddings, and stores them in pgvector tagged with bidderId and documentType.

endpoints.name: Ask Bidder-Tender Chatbot (Direct Node RAG)
endpoints.description: Executes semantic similarity vector search across both Tender specifications and Bidder submissions, retrieves the top matching chunks + ML statutory summary, constructs a prompt with citations, and generates Gemini LLM evaluation.

body.query: Does this bidder meet the minimum turnover requirement of INR 10 Crores and what are the financial risks?

200_OK.answer: Based on Section 4.2 of the Tender document (TND-001), the minimum required annual turnover is INR 10.0 Crores for the last 3 fiscal years. According to the audited financial statement submitted by Bidder BID-007, their average turnover is INR 14.2 Crores (FY23: 12.5 Cr, FY24: 14.8 Cr, FY25: 15.3 Cr). Therefore, the bidder COMPLIES with the financial eligibility criterion.

sources.textSnippet: Clause 4.2: The bidder must have an average annual financial turnover of at least INR 10 Crores...
Total revenue from operations for FY 2024-25 stands at INR 15,30,00,000...

endpoints.name: Ask Bidder-Tender Chatbot (Spring Boot Gateway Proxy)
endpoints.description: Recommended production endpoint used by Frontend. Spring Boot verifies officer authentication, handles tender validation, proxies the question to the Node AI RAG service, and returns structured evaluation results.

body.query: Evaluate the technical experience and past contract completions for this bidder.

200_OK.answer: Bidder BID-007 has provided documentation for 3 prior government procurement contracts totaling INR 35 Crores, exceeding the mandatory requirement of 2 completed similar works.

sources.textSnippet: Completion certificate issued by NHAI for project value 18.5 Cr...
